title: com.directory result: the addressable Projects of the caller's estate (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: Names, ids, listed capabilities, responder state and whether the operator holds a capability only: never a message, a body, a participant, a thread, a count, a generation, a lease, a lease holder or who set a hold, and never a Project of another estate or one its operator unlisted.

stale.description: The board answered from a projection it knows is behind: a Project listed or unlisted, or a responder enrolled or lapsed, may not show yet.

id.description: What com.submit addresses. Data, not authority.

name.description: The Project's name as its host shows it to the operator.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the Project takes requests for, as its host lists them.

responder.description: The state com.status reports for this capability: active, stale (its lease lapsed — not that it failed) or absent. No generation, lease time or holder.

held.description: The same fact as com.status's responders[].held (DEC-0079): true when the operator holds this capability's slot or the whole Project, so a request to it waits and its deadline keeps running; absent or false: not held. Never names who set the hold.

cursor.description: null when the listing is exhausted.
